title: Cheesecake Factory Deep-Dive Analysis
summary: Restaurant growth, acquisition economics and cash returns.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.claim: Mixed macro signals justify caution
claims.reason: The article explicitly declines to declare a confirmed turn. Conflicting nowcasts are not independent forecasts by the author.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

claims.claim: FRC broadens the growth pipeline
claims.reason: North Italia expansion and profitable FRC operations were observable by 2026, supporting strategic breadth. This does not establish acquisition return on capital, and initial expansion was interrupted in 2020.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: Preliminary first-quarter fiscal 2020 results
evidence.finding: Q1 comparable sales fell 12.9%. Company suspended dividends, buybacks and new-unit development; obtained $200 million convertible preferred financing and covenant relief.

evidence.title: First-quarter fiscal 2026 results
evidence.finding: North Italia had 49 units at March 31, 2026, versus 45 a year earlier. Both North Italia and other FRC segments were profitable; the company operated 36 licensed international Cheesecake Factory restaurants.

claims.claim: Delivery raises sales but dilutes margins
claims.reason: Off-premise sales helped survival during closures, but incremental contribution margin must be distinguished from restaurant-average margin and platform fees.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.
claims.next_check: Obtain comparable dine-in and delivery contribution margins, fees and incremental-order share.

claims.reason: Portfolio sizing can limit damage, but the underlying business required rescue capital and covenant relief. Diversification mitigates portfolio concentration, not the issuer's operating and financing risks.

claims.claim: In-money puts necessarily exercise before expiration
claims.reason: Touching or trading below strike before expiration does not force exercise. The holder controls early exercise, and assignment depends on exercise and allocation. The cash-secured strategy can still be coherent without this incorrect certainty.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: before March 20, 2020 expiration
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Options assignment FAQ
evidence.finding: American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

claims.claim: Put premium reduces effective purchase basis
claims.reason: For one assigned share, $40 strike minus $1.40 premium equals $38.60 before fees and taxes. The 3.6% period yield is arithmetic, not an independently repeatable annual return.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Cash-flow identity; downside remains that of ownership below net basis.

assessment: This article contains both a specific caution about severe equity downside and overconfident language about dividend durability and low risk. The first is not erased by the second. Acquisition expansion later materialized, but financing stress and payout suspension are decisive adverse evidence. The option mechanics include a factual mistake independent of investment performance.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
No complete adjusted total-return series or original-vintage macro database was available for this review. Unverified outcomes are explicitly unscored.
